reviews.text: A special thanks to Aurora and Sofia for their patience with our kiwi puppy for his first grooming ❤️

I took my little one for his first grooming, and I couldn't have chosen a better place!
Sofia was incredibly sweet, professional, and attentive: she treated him with incredible care and gentleness, making him feel immediately at ease. Ludovica was also incredibly kind and helpful, making us feel welcomed from the very first moment.
The result was simply stunning: fragrant, spotlessly clean, and beautiful! But above all, I was delighted to see how calm and pampered he was when I returned to pick him up.
Highly recommended! We'll definitely be back!

After the summer, my poodle was covered in knots. They did everything they could to accommodate me and not shave his fur completely.
With patience and love, they gave me back the most beautiful dog I've ever had. Thank you, as always, for your skill and love.

I brought my cat Artù today. He's very fearful, but Alessandro was excellent at instilling calm and security in him. Artù even had his hair done and spent an hour with him without batting an eyelid. Aurora, the owner, had already given me a quick phone call about their approach, especially to cats, and I was really satisfied. We'll definitely be back!

We've been customers of this grooming salon for a long time and have brought our dog here many times. Unfortunately, however, I find myself having to leave a negative review. This is already the second time that, despite explicitly requesting a trim, my dog ​​has only been returned washed and dried. There may have been an oversight once, but it's unfortunate to see this lack of attention to the requests of a regular customer after the second incident. It's a shame.

Since May 2020, "Non solo coccole 2" has been the go-to place for my dog's complete care. Over time, the shop has become a kind of second home, and until September 2025, we were welcomed like family. My dog ​​Lancia was treated like a queen every time she was groomed, and she was loved and pampered by all the staff.
The shop is spotless, stocked with every accessory our furry friends need. Above all, it is a place where animals are truly loved and respected.
Thanks to Mr. Attilio, Aurora, Maila, Sofia, Alessandro, and everyone who welcomed Lancia and contributed to her well-being.
We will keep you in our hearts forever.
Ileana and Lancia.

We went today to groom our three-year-old cat, expecting nothing much to accomplish due to his temperament. Instead, the grooming went really well; they managed to remove all the tangles and even clip him. Thank you so much!
Fantastic! We've been going to Uncle Ale's since our two-year-old poodle, Leo, was six months old. He has so much patience.

For us and home ..... Aurora and all the girls, and Alessandro are simply wonderful ... 😍. before we took Bianca ... who went up on the bridge two years ago 😌💔 now there is Snoopy who loves it madly🩵 I wouldn't change them for anything in the world 😍 Top ❤️❤️ …

I've been coming to them for several years to bring my Dante, and I must say it's always a pleasure! They're all exceptional, especially Aurora, who takes care of all of us with an incredible and professional welcome, giving love and cuddles to all her four-legged clients (for me, she's truly irreplaceable). A special thanks to Sofia, who now pampers Dante impeccably throughout his grooming, he smells wonderful for days and is attentive to every little detail, truly precious! Highly recommended!
I took my mini Toy poodle to be groomed, the guys are 100% professional, kind, and a real love for dog care. My dog ​​will always come back to them.
Highly recommended
If Macchia is happy to join, there must be a reason!
Very knowledgeable and kind staff

Super professional staff. I want to especially thank Alessandro, because he's professional and very attentive to my dog's every need. He's always happy to come into the shop and is always comfortable. Thank you all... Super satisfied.

We'd like to share the positive experience of grooming our dog Romeo, a white miniature poodle. Mayla and Alessandro are incredibly talented. With patience, professionalism, care, and affection, they worked tirelessly to return our dog Romeo to us—clean, fragrant, groomed, pure white, soft, and calm, all in accordance with his needs. Aurora, the receptionist, is also very kind, helpful, and knowledgeable in offering advice on all things dog. We're very happy with this place and highly recommend it for grooming and pet supplies.
Thank you Sofia, kind and very good at her job, it was the second time I brought my Poli and I am very satisfied, thank you Sofia, we will definitely see each other again.

Given that I've been taking my Westy puppy for grooming once a month for over a year, with the best results possible without stripping, it's with great disappointment that I have to report a repeated lack of grooming in the last three sessions. The dog comes home clean and smells great, but with no signs of grooming whatsoever.
Now, it's clear we're talking about a Westy, a white dog and prone to getting dirty, but honestly, for the modest sum of €35, I expected at least the private parts to be trimmed: ears as before, muzzle as before, tail as before, and skirt as bad as before because it's been raining!
The dog doesn't look like a dog who gets groomed once a month at all, in terms of grooming. He's a mass of matted hair, even on his ears, bottom, and paws. I reiterate this unfortunate situation, which has only occurred in the last few months. I understand that the Westy is unique in both his personality and coat, but honestly, it seems like he's never groomed and looks like a dirty rag the very next day, even though he lives in an apartment. I don't think he's been properly groomed in the last few months. I couldn't tell you in person because my husband drops him off and picks him up.

Raffaella
Simply fantastic. Minou thanks
Very professional people, I'm happy
They treated Maui with professionalism, care, and lots of attention. The price was fair for the work done. We will definitely be using them again. Thank you, Sofia.
Thank you for choosing us 😊 …
Kind and qualified staff.
Perfect grooming for your 4-legged friends, everything perfect and highly qualified staff, congratulations

They are excellent, very kind, and very professional. We brought our Maremmana for grooming for the first time.
We introduced her a few days beforehand to see how she would fare.
After the grooming, when we returned, she was perfect and beautiful, her fur shiny and smelling great.
Thank you to all the staff for your patience and care.

Excellent and competent, even with large and less-than-tame dogs, like my Czechoslovakian Wolfdog, who tried their spa tub with a special ozone bath for the first time this morning.
He's been suffering from furfural dermatitis for a few weeks now. He was constantly scratching himself until this morning before his bath, but since we left the groomer, I haven't seen him scratch even once 🙏🏻🤩
Not to mention his lovely, soft, shiny, and fragrant fur 🥰
Highly recommended for all dogs, but above all, we recommend the spa tub with an ozone bath from Non Solo Coccole 🐾

Those words from Jason 🐺, who's already been visibly better in just a few hours 🐾❤️

They are excellent and very sweet with the animals they bring in for grooming.
We will definitely be back soon. Furthermore, the owner, Mr. Iassini, gave us excellent advice on the most effective products to use for flea control.
They also have a large selection of food from the best brands and other pet supplies, including beds of various shapes and sizes, leashes, collars, toys, tags to engrave with the owners' contact information, clothing, and shoes for our furry friends. They have absolutely everything that could be useful for the well-being of our animals. But knowing the owner's expertise, expertise, and dedication, this is absolutely normal.
We thank the very kind Mr. Iassini so much, and also his lovely ladies who dedicated themselves to grooming the little dog, who was returned to you happy and soft as a cotton ball.
Thank you, Attilio. Thank you, Not just cuddles.
We will be back with Cuki soon. Greetings from Alessia Kuki and Francesco
Very kind, very good, very sweet with four-legged friends, competent and above all always with a smile
Very good at their job.

I've been bringing Nuvola, my Maremma, to them for a few years now. The staff is helpful, affectionate, and caring. Every time I walk into the shop, I feel right at home. Aurora is always ready to give me professional and proper advice on nutrition and other things, showering Nuvola with cuddles and love. 😊 While Sofia takes care of her grooming, she's a very sweet, apprehensive, and tender girl with her. She showers her with cuddles, and Nuvolina adores her. Thank you so much for everything you do, especially because you can tell it's done with love. 😘
Kind and courteous, with a focus on our dogs. I recommend him for grooming to anyone who owns a pet.
Very professional and good at dealing with furry friends and family.👍🐕 …
Great professionalism, they immediately put our dogs at ease. Recommended.
Spectacular and even more professional than it already was.. It is not recommended but it is a must... I confirm everything I have previously written.
Excellent welcome, courteous, professional in taking care of the dog (in my case), well-stocked food shop.
Super competent staff, very sweet with the animals and also with the owners ❣️
